title: Understanding L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization, also known as Ridge regression, tends to produce models with smaller coefficients. This is because it adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function.

title: Comparing Coefficients
text: Look at the coefficients of each version. Which version has the smallest coefficients overall? This might indicate the use of L2 regularization.
